options.balanced: A balance of power and control

currentRacquet.title: What racquet do you use today?
currentRacquet.description: Helps us understand what you're used to.

courtType.title: What surface do you play on most?

swingSpeed.title: How fast is your swing?
swingSpeed.description: Faster swings reward control-oriented racquets; compact swings need help from the frame.

options.compact: Compact — short strokes, I need power from the racquet
options.fast: Fast — I generate good pace myself

spinStyle.title: How do you use spin in your game?

options.moderate_spin: Moderate spin — I mix it up
options.slice: Lots of slice — variety and low balls

racquetFeel.title: What do you like and dislike about your current racquet?
racquetFeel.description: Feel at impact, maneuverability, vibration, power... in your own words.
racquetFeel.placeholder: E.g. I love the control but lack power on serve, and it vibrates a lot on off-center hits

strengths.title: What are the strengths of your game?
strengths.description: Shots, tactics or situations where you play your best.
strengths.placeholder: E.g. aggressive crosscourt forehand, consistent serve, good point construction in long rallies

improveGoals.title: What do you most want to improve or feel is missing?
improveGoals.placeholder: E.g. I want more depth on my backhand and feel rushed returning fast serves

physicalProfile.title: What's your physical profile and conditioning?
physicalProfile.description: Height, strength, endurance, age — whatever feels relevant.
physicalProfile.placeholder: E.g. 5'10", 34 years old, good conditioning, but my shoulder aches after long matches

anythingElse.title: Anything else we should know?
anythingElse.placeholder: E.g. I play local league tournaments and string with multifilament at 53 lbs
